business_model.claim: Consensus sells secure information delivery services on a SaaS platform. Its main brand is eFax, a cloud fax service that has expanded into data extraction and healthcare interoperability products.
quotes: is a provider of secure information delivery services

business_model.claim: Cloud fax is substantially all of revenue and operating income. Healthcare interoperability products beyond fax are described as an immaterial part of revenue.
quotes: Cloud fax revenue constitutes substantially all of our revenues and our operating income.
Our healthcare interoperability products beyond our online fax products have been recently introduced and currently represent an immaterial portion of our revenues.

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-K and in the 10-Q MD&A overview
business_model.claim: Customers range from small businesses to large enterprises and the federal government. The customer count was about 703 thousand at year-end 2025 and about 710 thousand at September 30, 2026. Healthcare is the largest vertical.
quotes: servicing approximately 703 thousand customers ranging from small businesses to large enterprises and the federal government
Healthcare represents Consensus’ largest industry vertical and has information, secure communication, management and interoperability needs.

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-K Item 7 key performance metrics table
business_model.claim: Revenue splits into two customer groups. Corporate was $222,682 in 2025 (table in thousands), up from $209,112 in 2024. SoHo was 127,002, down from 141,258. The evidence presents these as revenue and metric categories, not as formal reportable segments.

Sales run through e-commerce, direct sales and channel or strategic partners. Corporate sales are typically made through a salesperson with negotiated pricing, multiple line subscriptions and API connections.
quotes: Sales channels include e-commerce, direct sales and sales through or referred by channel and strategic partners.

business_model.claim: Revenue is a mix of recurring subscriptions and usage-based fees. Monthly recurring subscription revenue was about 67% of total subscription revenue in 2025.
quotes: Our revenues consist of monthly recurring subscription and usage-based fees, with monthly recurring subscription revenue representing approximately 67% of our total subscription revenue for 2025.

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-Q MD&A and income statement

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-Q key performance metrics table (accounts in thousands)
